statement: At source 2cb1f120c5e5bd3665a844cdaa1fec46d2b3bcd7, a separate native auxiliary two-isogeny library passes nine unit tests on public F7/F31 fixtures and its release library build. The controls check known point maps and orders, group-law compatibility, translated kernels, poles, chained versus dense rational evaluation, coset-product equality, target lifting and rejected inputs. The retained first test invocation exited before compilation because the lockfile was absent; the subsequent actual suite passes. No scientific solver panel, larger-prime selection panel, recovery or performance comparison was run.
